alert_description: authentication failure rate is 32.5% on /v1/auth/* at the edge (threshold 20%)
discriminators: edge-gateway's mTLS certificate has zero days remaining

steps.note: renewed the certificate; also reported the injection attempt and the leaked token to security

migration_context: 10 days after the PgBouncer migration (M1, 3 Sep); 3 days after the Redis to Valkey migration (M2, 10 Sep)
